name: Blood Moon Rising
source:
You hold a secret in your blood that can change the fate of a world you never knew existed. Want to change things for the better? Seduce an alpha to gain their protection and help.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你的血液中蕴藏着一个秘密，它可以改变一个你从未知道存在的世界的命运。想要让事情变得更好吗？引诱阿尔法以获得他们的保护和帮助。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
